gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-montagu-slab: Playful and wobbly, Jelly Crazies keeps every stroke end as wide as its middle, with bowls nearly sealed. Montagu Slab is the classic serif counterweight, with sturdy downstrokes, slender turns and an open e that reads easily.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-noto-serif-h: Noto Serif Hentaigana brings open jaws on its curves and small letters nearly as tall as capitals, under Jelly Crazies' wobbly, closed-up shapes. One is loose and bouncy, the other quietly traditional.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-ovo: Ovo reads tall and authoritative, its thin strokes barely lighter than the thick ones.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-domine: Joystix spaces its arcade letters far apart, with stems barely heavier than the arms joining them, a very bold look. Domine's dignified text serif, with room inside each curve, gives it something sturdy to stand beside.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-esteban: Refined next to Joystix's bold arcade lettering, Esteban shows lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals and an e that never pinches shut. Pick a generous size for it.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-faustina: Widely tracked and chunky, Joystix has stems barely heavier than the arms joining them. It handles loud arcade display, while Faustina, a classic serif with a pliers-like open c, handles the quieter reading.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-halant: Joystix is arcade lettering, widely tracked and bold.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-hedvig-letters-ser: Pixel-bold arcade lettering, widely tracked and loud. Hedvig Letters Serif follows with sturdy tall lowercase and open curves, so a long passage would feel steady and unhurried beside Joystix.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-lisu-bosa: Classic and editorial, Lisu Bosa has tall lowercase and counters spilling into the space around them. And Joystix, widely tracked and arcade-bold, gives the pair its strongest quality: a loud, playful opening before the text serif calms things.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, with gentle modulation, pulled-back terminals and a lowercase that carries real stature beside Joystix. Give it a larger size.
